summary.text: Brandon Daugherty, who works in hospitality management, was the Libertarian Party nominee for Missouri's 2nd District and lost the November 3, 2026 election to Fred Wellman.
A local Libertarian Party officer, he ran for the same seat in 2024; his 2024 Ballotpedia survey describes support for individual liberties, lower taxes and a non-interventionist foreign policy.

paragraphs.text: Daugherty was born in Columbia, Missouri, says he grew up in rural Warren County, and now lives in O'Fallon.
He earned an associate degree from St. Charles Community College in 2020 and works in hospitality management.
Daugherty has been affiliated with the St. Charles County Libertarian Party and described himself as its vice chair in his 2024 Ballotpedia survey.
He ran as the Libertarian candidate for Missouri's 2nd District in 2024, receiving about 2.1% of the vote behind Ann Wagner and Ray Hartmann, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Libertarian primary.
Daugherty received 2.7% of the vote to Fred Wellman's 51.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
